meta.title: Centrales électriques en France - Téléchargement gratuit
meta.description: Liste complète des centrales électriques en France. All 3,051 power generation and storage units in France from the powerplantmatching (PyPSA) merged European power plant dataset: name, fuel type, technology, capacity (MW), efficiency, commissioning/retrofit/retirement year, coordinates, storage attributes (duration, reservoir volume, dam height, storage capacity), ENTSO-E EIC codes and cross-referenced upstream source IDs (MaStR, ENTSO-E, JRC, GEM, GPD, OPSD, GEO and others). Contient 3051 enregistrements. Télécharger en formats Excel, CSV, PDF.
